label: Daily weather forecast
info: Sends today's forecast on WhatsApp every morning at 07:00. No key needed for the forecast service.

name: Setup
info: Before you run this flow: open the Turbo Notify account node, paste an API key and press Test. Your Turbo Notify account needs a WhatsApp number linked to it. The key needs the messages:send scope. Replace +12025550123 with the number that should receive the message. The forecast comes from the free Open-Meteo service. Change latitude and longitude in the address of the http request node to your city. Press the inject button to test now.
